reason: The money isn't the issue, $19 is nothing next to what goes into the build. I'd forward a handful of old nota from the group to see what it does with them, but I wouldn't pay this month. I'm not convinced it can read my foreman's scrawl on a building-supply nota, and I'd also have to get the staff to use it in the work group.
objection: A neat sheet of whatever my staff send me doesn't tell me if the nota is padded or if the cement was ever delivered. If it misreads handwritten Indonesian receipts, I end up with tidy wrong numbers that I trust more than the mess I have now, and I could put together a Zoho sheet or my own bot for free anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Watching it get a batch of my real handwritten supply-shop nota right and catch an actual double-claimed or wrongly added receipt that I would have missed.
